I'm fixing the import by pulling SelectChangeEvent from '@mui/material' and updating the change handler's type. I also want to flag that the codemod added variant="standard" to a Select inside an outlined FormControl. My read is that in v4 the Select picks up the FormControl's variant, so it was outlined before, and forcing "standard" changes how it looks.

I'm weighing whether to leave the codemod's variant="standard" alone or keep it out of scope, since it would change how the Select looks. The goal is to keep behavior unchanged, so I'll just flag it rather than alter it.
